selected_script.angle: A soft foam sponge just tears and crumbles against rough tile grout without lifting embedded dirt; switch to the durable V-shaped stand-up brush and professional formula to power through the grime easily.
selected_script.hook: Watch this foam sponge completely crumble to pieces against rough dirty grout.

timeline.scene: Foam sponge crumbling on rough grout.
Grout-eez bottle and V-shaped brush easily clean the line.
Bathroom grout restored to bright clean.
Text: Make your space cleaner and cozier.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a real-life wrong or inefficient behavior using close-up details—a white foam cleaning sponge crumbling and tearing into pieces as a hand tries to scrub deeply embedded dirt in a rough tile grout line. 3-6s: Quickly introduce the product as the direct solution and show the issue being fixed immediately. A white 32 oz Grout-eez cleaner bottle and a bright blue V-shaped stand-up grout brush replacing the wrong behavior. The blue brush smoothly drops into the grout line and effortlessly lifts the heavy grime. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the first clear result of sparkling clean bathroom tile grout. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment. Keep the pacing fast, clear, and product-focused. 9:16 realistic handheld phone-shot style. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity. Do not change the product color, shape, material, size ratio, logo position, texture, or visible structure. Do not invent extra accessories, buttons, lights, packaging, or exaggerated functions.
